rationale: Read prompt, all contract entries, starter, skeleton, hints, approach, criteria, harness, visible/hidden assertions and canonical reference. Clarify trusted current session and collector metadata, bounded ordinary inputs, ignored accessor fields, nonmutation, first normalized contact and original stored email. Correct helper timing against actual harness. Define combined document/contact count On target; broader consent/grant/delivery checks remain outside fixture. Three wrong implementations previously passed: harmless proposal identity read, document text read and normalized rather than stored recipient. New throwing getters, padded first contact, frozen-input and 1000-entry cases expose them. Reference unchanged and explicit-loop alternative both pass.
